answer: A newcomer files a voyage deed with the pulse panel: a land-title deed for its plot, the deed number and parcel number checked against the garden registry within thirty minutes of the nonce. The pulse panel matches the deed, the parcel number, and the signature. A deed reused under a second name fails, and the plot is barred for a cycle, forfeiting forty-six units. An honest owner pays forty-six units once; a thousand fakes pay forty-six thousand units. A farm reusing one deed for a thousand clones fails: one deed binds one parcel to one voyage.
